title: geo.geocode
description: Forward geocoding: address text -> normalized places. Returns the GeoJSON FeatureCollection dict {"type", "features", "lang"}; each feature's properties.formatted is the ready-to-display one-line label. Goes through the same cache + spend ledger as the HTTP proxy. Raises GeocoderError when the provider is unreachable (an empty features list means 'no match', not 'down').

lang.description: Requested language; clamped to what the provider's index actually carries (see PHOTON_LANGUAGES / PHOTON_LANGUAGE_FALLBACK). The language actually used comes back as "lang".

bbox.description: Hard restriction [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat]; defaults to STAPEL_GEO['MAP_BBOX'] at the HTTP layer only.
